children: The market underappreciates Newmont's recent deal with Barrick on its Fourmile project, according to UBS. Newmont has performed broadly in line with senior gold peers--excluding Barrick--since the deal, despite a significant improvement in visibility on cash returns and implied growth in gold equivalent ounces per share, the bank says. "A potential large cash payment from NEM to Barrick to equalize the ownership of [Barrick's] Fourmile project in the Nevada JV had been the key overhang for NEM's investment case," says UBS. It has a buy rating on Newmont's Australian shares, with a price target of 210.00 Australian dollars. The stock is up 2.6% at A$175.20. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
